title: Tuna Salad in Mini Cups
description: Tuna mixed with Greek yogurt and fresh vegetables, portioned into cups for grab-and-go convenience.
ingredients: 150 g canned tuna in water, drained
steps: Mix the yogurt with lemon juice and seasoning.
Fold in the tuna, cucumber and pepper.
Divide into small containers for the fridge.

source.label: Adapted from Epicurious no-mayo tuna salad

notes: Swapping mayo for Greek yogurt cuts the fat roughly in half while adding more protein per serving.
